results.caption: Honestly not bad.  Pretty chill zone 1 workout just insanely long.  Here’s the full story.  Do you think @Chris C needs to come to Mallorca?  Never swam more than 100 yards. Never biked more than 5 miles. Ran a couple marathons years ago and that’s it. Carb loading the day before did not go well. Basically no breakfast, pancakes for lunch, pasta for dinner, almost a gallon of apple juice. Ended up feeling sick most of the night and barely slept. Woke up rough and still got moving anyway. It’s not a hard day physically, it’s just really long and really boring. I was live on Instagram almost the entire time, which is also why my phone survived since I couldn’t charge it while running.  The only logistical way to fit a run, bike, and swim into one day was to do it in and around my apartment complex. Paced it close to the cutoff times on purpose. Could’ve gone faster but didn’t want to burn out. Did it anyway. Turns out it’s not hard, it’s just really long and really boring. #ironman #ironmantraining #ironmantriathlon #fullironman
